correctness.rationale: On reachable-density differences V (dim_R V<=d^2-1), synchronizing iff the real channel-letter linear product vanishes. The target word yields XY^n X^a=0 in right-to-left matrix multiplication; the shorter words X^a and XY^n X^(a-1) must not vanish, so im X^a is a proper nonzero subspace of im X^(a-1). Once consecutive image ranks stabilize they never decrease, forcing at least a prior strict drops plus nonzero a-th image: dim V>=a+1, d>=ceil(sqrt(a+2)). On U=R^(a+1), X fixes e0, kills e1 and shifts e_j to e_(j-1) for j>=2; Y rotates (e0,e1) by theta=pi/(2n), fixes others. X has rank loss at most one, Y invertible; killing e0 requires at least n Y letters because cos(j theta) never vanishes for 0<=j<n. Each zero product thus needs a+1 X letters and n Y letters. At the minimal total length the only possible mixed run candidate is 0^k1^n0^(a+1-k); evaluating e_(k+1) excludes k<a, leaving exactly 0^a1^n0. Embed U in traceless Hermitian d-dimensional operators and perturb the completely depolarizing channel by small epsilon; full-rank Choi positivity ensures CPTP while an initial near-maximally-mixed state produces reachable difference span U. An independent SymPy exact exhaustive matrix check verifies unique shortest zeros for 12 (a,n) pairs; no finite extrapolation.
